page.title: Reports
page.description: Pick a window, then read what happened in it.

read.noActivityHeadline: No activity recorded in this range.
read.noActivityDetail: Widen the date range, or clear a filter, to see something here.
read.keptHeadline: You kept {{net}} of the {{income}} that came in.
read.overspentHeadline: You spent {{net}} more than you brought in.
read.spendingUpJoined: and spending is up {{pct}}% on the period before
read.spendingDownJoined: and spending is down {{pct}}% on the period before
read.yourSpendingUp: Your spending is up {{pct}}% on the period before
read.yourSpendingDown: Your spending is down {{pct}}% on the period before

advisorPrompt.template: Looking at {{start}} to {{end}}, tell me {{focus}}. Use my actual transactions.

focus.overview: what stands out about my finances
focus.cashflow: how my cash flow moved and whether the trend is healthy
focus.spending: where my spending went and what I could cut
focus.budgets: which budgets I am at risk of blowing
focus.debt: which debt I should attack first and why

chart.defaultEmpty: Nothing to chart for this range.

cashflow.title: Money in, money out, and what was left
cashflow.hint: Bars are the two flows; the line is what survived each period.
cashflow.empty: No income or expenses landed in this range.

ranked.title: Where it went
ranked.empty: No categorised expenses in this range.

savingsRate.title: Savings rate by month
savingsRate.hint: Share of each month's income you did not spend. Below the line means you dipped into reserves.
savingsRate.empty: Needs at least one month with recorded income.

waterfall.title: What each month did to your balance
waterfall.hint: Each bar starts where the last one ended, so the steps trace your running total.

balanceHistory.title: Balance history
balanceHistory.hint: Daily running balance per account. Total is the thick line.
balanceHistory.empty: No active accounts match this filter.

table.title: Period by period
table.hint: The same numbers as a table, for when you need the exact figure.

byCategory.title: Spending by category
byCategory.hint: Tile area is the share of total spend.
byCategory.empty: No categorised expenses in this range.

merchants.title: Top 10 payees
merchants.hint: Grouped by the description on each transaction.

weekday.title: Your week
weekday.hintDefault: Spend split across the days of the week.
weekday.hintPeak: {{day}} is your heaviest day — {{pct}}% of everything you spent in this range.

mom.title: Month-on-month change
mom.hint: How each month's spend compares with the one before it.
mom.empty: Needs at least two months of expenses to compare.

empty.title: No budgets to measure
empty.description: Create a budget and this tab will show how close each one is to its limit.

summary.allComfortable: Every budget is comfortably inside its limit.
summary.tight_one: {{count}} budget is close to the limit.
summary.tight_other: {{count}} budgets are close to the limit.
summary.description: {{spent}} spent against {{limit}} budgeted, across {{count}} budget. Sorted by how much of each is used.
summary.description_other: {{spent}} spent against {{limit}} budgeted, across {{count}} budgets. Sorted by how much of each is used.

empty.title: No debts tracked
empty.description: Add a debt and this tab will show payoff progress, interest cost, and which one to clear first.

stats.interestHint: The part of your payments that bought nothing

recommendation.title: Clear {{name}} first.
recommendation.description: At {{rate}}% it is your most expensive debt, so every euro sent there saves more than the same euro sent anywhere else. Keep the minimum payment on the rest while you do it.

progress.title: Payoff progress
progress.description: Ordered by interest rate — most expensive first.
progress.clearBy: · clear by {{date}} at the current minimum payment
progress.setMinimum: · set a minimum payment to project a payoff date
